# `always-comb-order`: Combinational block reads a value before writing it / 组合过程先读取后写入中间变量

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

An always_comb block consumes an intermediate variable before a later statement assigns that variable in the same activation.

### Risk

The read can observe the previous value, creating state-like behavior or results that vary between simulators.

### Fix

Order assignments by dependency so every intermediate value is written before it is read, or separate the logic into clear dependency stages.

## 简体中文

### 原因

always_comb 过程在一次执行中先使用某个中间变量，随后才在后面的语句中给它赋值。

### 风险

读取操作可能取得该变量的旧值，从而产生类似状态保持的行为，或造成不同仿真器结果不一致。

### 修复

按依赖顺序排列赋值，确保中间变量先写后读；必要时将逻辑拆成依赖关系清晰的阶段。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module always_comb_order(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  logic intermediate;

  always_comb begin
    y = a & intermediate;
    intermediate = b;
  end
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module always_comb_order(input logic a, input logic b, output logic y);
  logic intermediate;

  always_comb begin
    intermediate = b;
    y = a & intermediate;
  end
endmodule
```
